tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 46.32 Lakhs
Executed in one year for a continuous period of 12 months the following minimum quantities of work in any of the urban local bodies. 1. Providing man power services to any ULB-14 Nos
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. 13.90 Lakhs Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc
Satisfactorily completed at least one similar works of Supplying of man power services to any ULB of value not less than Rs. 23.16 lakhs, as prime contractor
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e.,2021-22 to 2025-26
Valid Labour license by Labour department, Government of Karnataka
